levels.title: Select with WHERE
levels.task: The promotions team is building a highlight reel just for Sabrina Carpenter. Find all the songs she has on the chart so they can prep the materials.
levels.solution: SELECT * FROM top_songs WHERE artist = 'Sabrina Carpenter';
levels.hintMessage: Use WHERE artist = 'Sabrina Carpenter' to filter.
levels.successMessage: Awesome! You just pulled everything Sabrina-related.

levels.title: Select with WHERE Greater Than
levels.task: Your manager wants to know which songs have over 2 billion Spotify streams-these are top-tier hits the label wants to spotlight.
levels.hintMessage: Use > to find values greater than 2,000,000,000.
levels.successMessage: You nailed it! These songs are the cream of the crop.

levels.title: Select with WHERE Dates
levels.task: A famous blogger is writing a blog post about music before covid and how covid shifted the music industry. Can you find all songs released before January 1st, 2020?
levels.solution: SELECT track_name, artist, release_date FROM top_songs WHERE release_date < '2020-01-01';
levels.successMessage: Nice work! Now they’ve got all the data they need.

levels.title: Select with WHERE for Two Elements
levels.task: Your team is preparing a report with their suggested artists for Coachella but they want to exclude the genres Country and Folk from their list. Can you give me all the artists that aren’t country or folk? Don’t forget to remove duplicates.
levels.solution: SELECT DISTINCT artist FROM top_songs WHERE genre != 'Country' AND genre != 'Folk';
levels.hintMessage: Use AND to combine multiple exclusions, use != for not equal to, and use DISTINCT to remove duplicates.
levels.successMessage: Great filtering! Those artists are all set for Coachella.

levels.title: Select with WHERE for 2 Different Elements
levels.task: You’ve been asked to do a feature on Morgan Wallen’s most streamed album. Start by finding songs where the artist is Morgan Wallen and the album is "One Thing At A Time".
levels.solution: SELECT track_name, artist, album_name FROM top_songs WHERE artist = 'Morgan Wallen' AND album_name = 'One Thing At A Time';
levels.successMessage: Perfect! Now the feature can highlight just the right songs.
